content.short: Block Lottos is a wallet-based blockchain lottery with Polygon and Base games.
content.description: Block Lottos is a multi-chain blockchain lottery platform where users pick 6 numbers, connect a wallet, and submit their own ticket transactions for Polygon Fortune Ledger or Base Future Ledger games. The site publishes public game pages, contract information, draw data, OpenAPI docs, llms.txt, agents.txt, an agent manifest, affiliate information, and advertising endpoints so players, directories, bots, and AI agents can inspect the platform before use. Users remain responsible for reviewing every wallet transaction before signing.
